channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Ime Udoka | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Ime Udoka from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Alperen Sengun on Ime Udoka
item.description:
As one example, Sengun pointed to an online controversy surrounding a postgame quote from Ime Udoka regarding Sengun’s pick-and-roll defense.

“When I first saw that press conference, what Udoka said didn’t hurt or upset me at all,”

Alperen Sengun on Ime Udoka, Jul 28, 2026. Source: Clutch Fans.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Kevin Durant on what stands out about Ime Udoka, entering their first playoff run together in Houston:

“Attention to detail. He understands the game on a deeper level. … He’s created a great culture in the locker room.”

Kevin Durant on Ime Udoka, Apr 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: RC Buford on Ime Udoka, Mike Budenholzer, James Borrego, Brett Brown, Will Hardy
item.description:
RC Buford:

“I think we had many coaches over the last 10 years who could have stepped into that role. Ime Udoka was with us, along with James Borrego, Brett Brown, Mike Budenholzer, and Will Hardy. There were many people with us who could have stepped into that role, but the longer Coach Pop stayed, the more those coaches moved on to other opportunities. When we needed Mitch to step up, he did so in a big way. It was incredibly emotional for him to take on that role. ‘Interim’ is probably the wrong word, because at the time of Pop’s stroke, we didn’t know whether Pop could come back. Mitch had that year to show the players—and all of us—who he could be as a coach.”

RC Buford on Ime Udoka, Mike Budenholzer, James Borrego, Brett Brown, Will Hardy, Mar 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Amen Thompson on Ime Udoka
item.description:
“But at the same time, it’s a next-man-up kind of thing. He wouldn’t want anyone to sulk off of him, so it’s the next man up.[Udoka] just told me, ‘You were going to get more on-ball reps anyway, but now you and Reed’s reps are going to be boosted.’ I was just excited for the opportunity.”

Amen Thompson on Ime Udoka, Dec 4, 2025. Source: Andscape.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Ime Udoka, Rafael Stone
item.description:
Speaking at practice on Monday just before the team flew to Oklahoma City, Kevin Durant said he was willing to sacrifice money to maximize the Rockets’ team-building opportunities.

“Just talking to Rafael (Stone) and Ime (Udoka) and how they wanted to build the team, and how I seen myself in this organization, I just thought it was a perfect contract for it,”

Kevin Durant on Ime Udoka, Rafael Stone, Oct 20, 2025. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Steph Curry on the Ime Udoka back-and-forth:

“He made a reservation to International Smoke and canceled it. I was upset with him.”

Stephen Curry on Ime Udoka, Apr 7, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Mazzulla on what he learned from his year on Ime Udoka’s Celtics staff:

“Able to understand the ebbs & flows of a season. I think the way he navigated (an) NBA locker room, the way he navigated an NBA season, he just had a knack for it because he played & he coached.”

Joe Mazzulla on Ime Udoka, Jan 4, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Brook Lopez on Ime Udoka
item.description:
“There was a lot of mutual interest. Watching this season, they’ve obviously done some great things. I love what Ime (Udoka, the Rockets’ first-year coach) has been doing. Obviously, the group of guys they have here have done great stuff.”

Brook Lopez on Ime Udoka, Jan 6, 2024. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Ime Udoka
item.description:
“We would watch film, and [Udoka] would pause it and it'd be a time when I was guarding Bron and I let him get past me, and he would be like ‘yo, y'all not friends, y'all not homies, you're trying to get to where he's at.' It was that mentality every day,”

Jayson Tatum on Ime Udoka, Dec 6, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jabari Smith on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Salman Ali:Jabari Smith on what advice new head coach Ime Udoka has given him so far:

“Out here at Summer League he’s just telling me to lead. To use my voice. It’s better to learn how to lead earlier than later. And focus on defense and ways to help this team.”

Jabari Smith on Ime Udoka, Jul 9, 2023. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Kevin Porter Jr on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Kevin Porter Jr. on the potential of major roster changes this offseason:

“I trust Ime [Udoka] with that. With whatever we’ve got right now, whoever comes in, whoever stays… I’m with it. Whoever is part of the lineup, we’ll be ready.”

Kevin Porter Jr on Ime Udoka, Jun 3, 2023. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Ime Udoka
item.description:
“They were inconsistent, but they were rooting for each other. They were all defending Joe in the media. You see Joe’s toughness and stubbornness. He’s a relentless worker. He has a passion to learn. Joe is a leader, and I think this was a difficult situation with the high expectations the team had coming in. I don’t think there’s anybody there that doesn’t believe that Joe is better than Ime [Udoka] as a coach.”

Danny Ainge on Ime Udoka, Jun 2, 2023. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Ime Udoka
item.description:
John Karalis:Marcus Smart on the Ime Udoka report:

“No. No. Regardless of if Ime was here or not, we’re the ones out there playing. We gotta go out there and play. ... It’s on us. There's only so much any coach can do for you out there as a player. At some point you gotta look at yourself & figure it out”

Marcus Smart on Ime Udoka, May 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @John_Karalis.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Tilman Fertitta on hiring Ime Udoka:

“It was a tough decision but it wasn't. There was one person that we felt was an exceptional candidate to take us to the next level... He is everything that the Rockets were looking for.”

Tilman Fertitta on Ime Udoka, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @clutchfans.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Tilman Fertitta on Ime Udoka:

“Some things maybe we shouldn't forgive people for but I think what happened in his personal situation is definitely something we forgive for.”

Tilman Fertitta on Ime Udoka, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Ime Udoka, Rafael Stone
item.description:
Fertitta:

“There's nothing like cap space. We have approximately $60 million available. I'm expecting a lot of these guys (Udoka, Stone.)”

Tilman Fertitta on Ime Udoka, Rafael Stone, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Sean Marks on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Sean Marks on whether the Nets would be comfortable hiring Udoka:

“Obviously, there's a reason why we made this move when we did, because time is ticking. So we do want this process to be a thorough one. We're not going to skip steps on that. And we'll do our due diligence.”

Sean Marks on Ime Udoka, Nov 2, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Chris Mannix:Jaylen Brown:

“I wish we had more details [about the Udoka suspension]. From what we know, it’s hard to make a decision whether it’s consensual or not... I guess there is more to it, possibly. We don’t know.”

Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @SIChrisMannix.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Brian Robb:Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka allegiations:

“We were all shocked by what was going on. A little confused. A lot of the information wasn't being shared with us so we can't really comment on it.”

Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Brian Robb:Jayson Tatum on reaction to Ime Udoka suspension:

“I guess I feel like everybody else. It's a lot to process. Unexpected especially coming into the season when you feel a certain way... It's just a lot if I'm being honest.”

Jayson Tatum on Ime Udoka, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Mazzulla on if he's talked to Udoka:

“I’ve talked to everyone in the organization & I thought it was my job to listen and give people space and time & ask people what they need. I've spoken to everyone I felt like needed to be spoken to and I've built relationships with, so yes.”

Joe Mazzulla on Ime Udoka, Sep 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Barnes said in an Instagram post Friday.

“I spoke on Ime Udoka’s defense. After finding out the facts after I spoke, I erased what I posted because this situation in Boston is deep, it’s messy, it’s 100 times uglier than any of us thought. That’s why I erased what I said.”

Matt Barnes on Ime Udoka, Sep 25, 2022. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Wyc Grousbeck on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Wyc Grousbeck on why Udoka was suspended and not fired:

“This felt right, but there’s no clear guidelines for any of this. This is really a conscious, gut feel and being here 20 years. I’m responsible for the decision, ultimately.”

Wyc Grousbeck on Ime Udoka, Sep 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Ime Udoka
item.description:
More Dejounte Murray on Ime Udoka:

“'Who cares that you missed that shot? I just want you to play hard. That comes with the game. As long as you play hard and give it your all, I’m gonna back you up 110%.’ That’s the type of coach you want to play for.”

Dejounte Murray on Ime Udoka, Jun 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Jaylen Brown, Derrick White, Ime Udoka
item.description:
Dejounte Murray on Ime Udoka:

“I knew Jayson, Jaylen, the rest of the core – and they’ve got D. White over there now -- but I just knew their whole core would love him because he really loves basketball. He’s a motivator. He’ll tell you, ‘Who cares that you turned it over?'”

Dejounte Murray on Jaylen Brown, Derrick White, Ime Udoka, Jun 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @mikecwright.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Keith Smith:Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka:

“Ime has put the ball in my hands more than any time in my career. He's challenging me to make plays. Sometimes I make the wrong read, but it happens. I'm human. But when I have the ball, I'm going to make something happen.”

Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka, Jun 3, 2022. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Celtics star Jaylen Brown told Yahoo Sports.

“Look around the league. Now you’re starting to see what we can do in the coaching ranks. Before, the talk was that certain people of color were not qualified to do their jobs or whatever the excuse was. Man, you give these guys an opportunity and look what they did with it. First-year head coach Ime Udoka took us to the Finals. Look at Monty Williams in Phoenix, look at Dallas with Jason Kidd. You look at all these coaches around the league, and I’m happy to see that they’re finally getting an opportunity. Black coaches and people of color are deserving and they’re capable of getting the job done just like anybody else.”

Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka, May 31, 2022. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Al Horford, Ime Udoka
item.description:
Erik Spoelstra on illness starting to affect availability in this series with Horford in protocol and Udoka sick:

“It’s really disappointing. Every time you think it’s behind us, it’s not and it’s really frustrating for us. You don’t want to see it on both sides.”

Erik Spoelstra on Al Horford, Ime Udoka, May 18, 2022. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Jayson Tatum on Ime Udoka:

“He’s done an unbelievable job in his first years, all the expectations and obviously all the ups and downs at the beginning of the season and how we turned it all around... It’s kind of a shame he's not one of the finalists for coach of the year.”

Jayson Tatum on Ime Udoka, Apr 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka
item.description:
Brian Robb:Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka's comments about his mind-boggling in consistency:

“It's mind-boggling to me too... I don't think he's out of line or anything.”

Jaylen Brown on Ime Udoka, Oct 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.
